newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S COMBINED DOWNHILL DELAYED.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S COMBINED DOWNHILL DELAYED.

text.p: The women's combined downhill at the Alpine skiing world championships was delayed by one hour to 1000 GMT on Friday because of the weather.
The latest delay was due to wind and to snow, which began falling overnight and dumped several centimetres on the piste. The race was called off on Thursday due to wind.
The race jury were inspecting the piste at 0900 but the conditions made it likely that they would either order a further delay or abandon any attempt at racing on Friday.
The slalom leg of the combined was held on Thursday night. Italy's Morena Gallizio was the fastest in that.
